definitions.gloss: approximate number; rough figure; round number
definitions.explanation: A number that is not exact but gives a general idea of the quantity. Used in mathematics education, statistics, and everyday reporting when precise figures are unnecessary or unavailable.

examples.japanese: {概数|がいすう}で{答|こた}えなさい。
examples.english: Give your answer as an approximate number.

examples.japanese: {参加|さんか}{人数|にんずう}は{概数|がいすう}で{三百人|さんびゃくにん}ほどだった。
examples.english: The number of participants was roughly three hundred.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{算数|さんすう}で{概数|がいすう}の{求|もと}め{方|かた}を{習|なら}った。
examples.english: I learned how to calculate approximate numbers in elementary school math.

notes:
Compound of {概|がい} (approximate; general) + {数|すう} (number). Taught as a formal mathematical concept in Japanese elementary school (typically 4th grade), where students learn rounding ({四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概数|がいすう}で{表|あらわ}す: to express as an approximate number
- {概数|がいすう}で{答|こた}える: to answer with a rough figure
- {概数|がいすう}の{求|もと}め{方|かた}: how to calculate approximate numbers
- {概数|がいすう}を{使|つか}う: to use approximate numbers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {約|やく}: approximately — prefix for approximate quantities; more casual ({約|やく}{百人|ひゃくにん})
- おおよそ: roughly; approximately — adverb used conversationally
- {四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}: rounding (off) — the specific method of rounding to the nearest value
- {端数|はすう}: fraction; odd amount — the remainder that gets dropped when rounding
